authorized_representative.quote: Landlord designates Alicia Moreno as the sole representative authorized to deliver and receive notices, grant consents and execute amendments on Landlord’s behalf under this Lease.

base_rent_monthly.quote: The initial Monthly Base Rent is $16,200.00 per month.

cam_estimate_psf_annual.quote: Landlord’s current estimate of Operating Expenses is $9.75 per rentable square foot per annum, payable in monthly installments of $4,387.50 concurrently with Base Rent.

commencement.quote: The term of this Lease (the “Term”) shall commence on April 1, 2024 (the “Commencement Date”) and shall expire at 11:59 p.m. on March 31, 2029 (the “Expiration Date”), unless sooner terminated or extended in accordance with the provisions of this Lease.

escalation_amount.quote: Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by 3.25% per annum.

escalation_kind.quote: Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by 3.25% per annum.

expiration.quote: The term of this Lease (the “Term”) shall commence on April 1, 2024 (the “Commencement Date”) and shall expire at 11:59 p.m. on March 31, 2029 (the “Expiration Date”), unless sooner terminated or extended in accordance with the provisions of this Lease.

proportionate_share_pct.quote: Tenant’s Proportionate Share is 11.13%, computed as the rentable area of the Premises divided by the rentable area of the Building.

renewal_count.quote: Provided no event of default is then continuing, Tenant shall have one (1) option to extend the Term, each for an additional period of 5 years, on all of the terms and conditions of this Lease except that Base Rent during each extension period shall be determined under Section 11.3.

renewal_notice_days.quote: Each option shall be exercised, if at all, by written notice delivered to Landlord not less than 270 days prior to the then-current Expiration Date.

renewal_years.quote: Provided no event of default is then continuing, Tenant shall have one (1) option to extend the Term, each for an additional period of 5 years, on all of the terms and conditions of this Lease except that Base Rent during each extension period shall be determined under Section 11.3.

rentable_sf.quote: The Premises are stipulated to contain 5,400 rentable square feet.

security_deposit.quote: Concurrently with Tenant’s execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of $32,400.00 as a security deposit for the faithful performance of Tenant’s obligations hereunder.

uncertain: Extension-period Base Rent (Section 11.3, page 7) is the greater of the final-month Monthly Base Rent and 95% of a fair market rental rate to be determined later; the fair market rate is not stated, so first-year extension rent cannot be derived and is not extracted.

Section 11.1 grants 'one (1) option' but uses the word 'each' ('each for an additional period of 5 years'); renewal_count was read as 1 from the explicit number, but the phrasing should be confirmed by a human.

The $9.75 per rentable square foot per annum is described as Landlord's current estimate of Operating Expenses, subject to annual reconciliation (Section 4.6) and a 5% controllable expense cap (Section 4.5); actual amounts may differ. The stated monthly installment of $4,387.50 equals $9.75 x 5,400 RSF / 12.
